name: @agentic-toolkit/editing
description: The editing container: one owner of the draft, the Save button and the unsaved-changes guard for every editable surface.
comment:exports: TWO named entries, on purpose, and NEVER a wildcard. The bound controls live in src/controls.tsx and no export key reaches them, so there is no import path that produces a control outside a container — that unreachability IS the compile-time enforcement, and one `./*` key retires it silently. frontend/tools/check_editing_boundary.py (in adh) fails CI if a key, an entry or the barrel drifts. `./server` is the declarative half (descriptors + sections, no React) built as its own chunk graph so `use client` cannot be hoisted onto it — see tsup.config.ts. `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR, no build/restart); prod (NODE_ENV=production) skips it → dist.
